name: 雪球评论爬取
description: 爬取一篇雪球帖子下的评论（用户/内容/点赞/时间），支持分页。需雪球登录态。

inputs.name: url
inputs.description: 雪球帖子链接；不填则用当前标签页

body.name: js

args.expression: (async()=>{const want=(p)=>{p=(p||'').trim();return (!p||p[0]==='$')?'':p;};const target=want('$url');const isArt=()=>/xueqiu\.com\/\d+\/\d+/.test(location.href);if(target&&location.href!==target&&!isArt()){location.href=target;const t0=Date.now();while(Date.now()-t0<20000&&!isArt())await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,500));}if(!isArt())return {ok:false,error:'not-article-page',hint:'请传入雪球帖子链接（xueqiu.com/<uid>/<postid>）'};const pid=(location.href.match(/\/(\d+)\/(\d+)/)||[])[2];const page=Math.max(1,Number('$page')||1);const count=Math.max(1,Math.min(Number('$limit')||20,100));const r=await fetch('https://xueqiu.com/statuses/comments.json?id='+pid+'&page='+page+'&count='+count,{credentials:'include'}).then(x=>x.json());const list=r.comments||[];return {ok:true,postUrl:location.href,page:page,fetched:list.length,comments:list.map(c=>({user:c.user&&c.user.screen_name,text:(c.text||'').replace(/<[^>]+>/g,'').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim().slice(0,500),likes:c.like_count||0,time:c.created_at?new Date(c.created_at).toISOString().slice(0,19).replace('T',' '):null})),total:r.total!==undefined?r.total:null};})()

body.note: 走雪球官方评论接口（页面上下文，带登录态）
